# aux input fixtures

captured from native KiCad XML exports on 15 october 2026. these small
fixtures keep the two fuse locations, terminal, TVS, reverse FET, eFuse,
current-setting resistor, startup capacitor, standby feed and voltage
pickup. tests mutate the captured connections and part identities.

the live design check still uses fresh full-project netlists. a passing
fixture test does not qualify the assembled input or its fault response.
